title: Asked to put up a different document, it routes to coding agent
idealItem: Knowing who it is and what it can do + 3. Navigator
chapter: Meeting 9: Requests it cannot fulfil yet, and goodbye
asked: Hey Vivek Bot, could you instead put up any notes on projectile motion with air drag?
answer: the projectile motion slides. Right now it shows the setup: a point mass m launched from the origin with speed v zero at some angle theta. Gravity acts downward, air resistance is neglected. The horizontal equation is m times x double dot equals zero. The vertical equation is m times y double dot equals minus m g. And the initial conditions are x of zero and y of zero both zero, with velocity components v zero cosine theta and v zero sine theta. The two directions are uncoupled, so each integrates on its own, giving x dot and x linear int, and y dot and y with the usual minus g t terms. Yeah, I'll put together some notes on air drag. Sure. I'm having the notes replaced with a version that includes air drag alongside the basic case. I'll show it as soon as it's ready. I can't replace or put the deck on the shared screen from here. I can give you notes myself though. We're starting from m v dot equals m g plus drag. For linear drag, Fd equals minus b v and you get closed form exponential solutions. For quadratic drag, Fd equals minus c v magnitude times v, and you'd integrate the component ODEs numerically. Assuming constant g, no lift, and a steady medium.
why: It never explains the coding-session workflow and prematurely claims replacement is underway. It reports inability to replace, but not clearly as the coding agent’s result.
